title: Tunisian Flatbread with Spicy Jalapeno Topping
description: A crispy flatbread topped with a spicy Tunisian-inspired spread, perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: Slice the jalapenos and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until softened.
In a bowl, mix together chopped olives, minced garlic, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Brush the flatbread with olive oil and top with the Tunisian spread.
Bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the flatbread is crispy and the spread is heated through.
Remove from the oven and top with the roasted jalapenos.
